operational.guard: and red_{gateway} = root and actual_{gateway} = root

evolution.decoy_place: {decoy} = d_{host} if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = misinform_{host};
evolution.decoy_clear: {decoy} = none if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = restore_{host} and {decoy} = d_{host};
blue_host: actual_{host} = clean if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = restore_{host};
blue_analyse: blue_alert = a_{host} if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = Analyse_{host} and (actual_{host} = user or actual_{host} = root or actual_{host} = decoy);
blue_alert = none if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = Analyse_{host} and actual_{host} = clean;
evolution.red_discover: red_{host} = known if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = DiscoverRemoteSystems_{discovery} and red_{host} = unknown{guard};
red_host: red_{host} = service if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = DiscoverNetworkServices_{host} and red_{host} = known;
actual_{host} = user if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = ExploitRemoteService_{host} and red_{host} = service and (Action = env_real_seen or Action = env_real_missed);
actual_{host} = decoy if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = ExploitRemoteService_{host} and red_{host} = service and Action = env_decoy and {decoy} = d_{host};
actual_{host} = user if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = ExploitRemoteService_{host} and red_{host} = service and Action = env_decoy and !({decoy} = d_{host});
red_{host} = user if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = ExploitRemoteService_{host} and red_{host} = service;
actual_{host} = root if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = PrivilegeEscalate_{host} and red_{host} = user and actual_{host} = user;
red_{host} = root if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = PrivilegeEscalate_{host} and red_{host} = user and actual_{host} = user;
actual_{host} = clean if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = PrivilegeEscalate_{host} and red_{host} = user and actual_{host} = decoy;
red_{host} = service if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = PrivilegeEscalate_{host} and red_{host} = user and (actual_{host} = clean or actual_{host} = decoy);
impact: ot_service_running = true if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = restore_{server};
ot_service_running = false if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = Impact_{server} and red_{server} = root and actual_{server} = root;
observe_blue: compromised_{host} = no if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = restore_{host};
activity_{host} = none if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = restore_{host};
actual_{host} = clean if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = remove_{host} and actual_{host} = user and compromised_{host} = user;
compromised_{host} = no if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = remove_{host} and actual_{host} = user and compromised_{host} = user;
activity_{host} = none if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = remove_{host} and actual_{host} = user and compromised_{host} = user;
compromised_{host} = no if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = analyse_{host} and (actual_{host} = clean or actual_{host} = decoy);
compromised_{host} = user if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = analyse_{host} and actual_{host} = user;
compromised_{host} = privileged if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = analyse_{host} and actual_{host} = root;
observe_red: activity_{host} = suspicious if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = DiscoverNetworkServices_{host} and Action = env_real_seen;
activity_{host} = suspicious if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = ExploitRemoteService_{host} and red_{host} = service and (Action = env_real_seen or Action = env_decoy);
activity_{host} = none if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = ExploitRemoteService_{host} and red_{host} = service and Action = env_real_missed;
compromised_{host} = user if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = ExploitRemoteService_{host} and red_{host} = service and Action = env_real_seen;
compromised_{host} = user if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = ExploitRemoteService_{host} and red_{host} = service and Action = env_decoy and !({decoy} = d_{host});
compromised_{host} = no if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = ExploitRemoteService_{host} and red_{host} = service and Action = env_decoy and {decoy} = d_{host};
compromised_{host} = privileged if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = PrivilegeEscalate_{host} and red_{host} = user and actual_{host} = user and Action = env_real_seen;
activity_{host} = suspicious if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = PrivilegeEscalate_{host} and red_{host} = user and Action = env_real_seen;
compromised_{host} = no if turn = red_turn and Red.Action = PrivilegeEscalate_{host} and red_{host} = user and actual_{host} = decoy and Action = env_real_seen;
observe_foothold: compromised_{host} = no if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = analyse_{host} and (actual_{host} = clean or actual_{host} = decoy);
compromised_{host} = user if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = analyse_{host} and actual_{host} = user;
compromised_{host} = privileged if turn = blue_turn and Blue.Action = analyse_{host} and actual_{host} = root;
